purpose: Test whether one smooth, baryon-derived potential-depth transition can leave the spent SPARC galaxy regime close to ordinary AQUAL while supplying the broad radial cluster amplification isolated by P0682, before any 3D solve, raw topology score, or sealed outcome is opened.

equation.field_form: div[mu_0(|grad Phi|/a0)^p(chi_b) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b
equation.baryonic_potential_coordinate: chi_b=|Phi_b|/c^2 with Phi_b(infinity)=0 and Phi_b(r)=integral_r^infinity g_bar(s) ds
equation.primary_interpretation: one local channel in shallow potential transitions toward four spacetime-channel factors in deep potential; this interpretation is a hypothesis, not a derivation

diagnostic_sensitivity_grid.selection_role: response mapping only; p_infinity or n values other than the primary dimension-fixed pair cannot advance a candidate

spent_galaxy_test.observable: outer-holdout adjusted circular speed under the already-spent nuisance solution
spent_galaxy_test.potential_closure: integrate each measured outer profile to its last radius and close with a point-mass tail
spent_galaxy_test.claim_limit: development transfer, not new-galaxy validation and not a full disk AQUAL solve

spent_cluster_test.target: mean baryonic reduced deflection plus mean radial compact-halo deflection in each P0682 annular bin
spent_cluster_test.prediction: spherical line-of-sight deflection of the algebraic acceleration at reference source redshift z=2
spent_cluster_test.claim_limit: the target is a spent low-parameter comparator, not a unique halo truth map

solar_proxy.warning: force screening is not a PPN derivation and cannot establish the Cassini gamma bound

selection_rule: Among only p_infinity=4 and n=2 rows that pass the galaxy and Solar gates, select the chi_t with the lowest all-five-cluster log RMS; ties within 1e-6 dex choose the larger chi_t. Advance it to a frozen 3D field/topology implementation only if every advancement gate passes. Diagnostic endpoints cannot advance even if they score better.
claim_boundary: P0683 is an algebraic/spherical reconnaissance of a proposed field coefficient, not a solved disk or cluster field equation.
The potential coordinate is baryon-derived but a future relativistic theory must replace or justify its Newtonian zero-at-infinity definition covariantly.
The four-channel interpretation is dimensional motivation, not a microscopic derivation.
The photon response is assumed equal to the matter response only for this spent deflection screen; no metric action or PPN prediction exists yet.
No raw image multiplicity, parity, critical curve, or positional likelihood is scored.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 additional-cluster outcomes remain sealed.
